newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products flat, except strong gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products flat, except strong gas oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly flat on Thursday, except gas oil which rallied strongly.
Gasoline was stable with Eurograde barges offers, flat with October and November swaps, at $207.
Naphtha was also marking time. The market is very tight, with sellers of small Russian cargoes having withdrawn.
Gas oil rallied strongly again as IPE futures again moved into five-year highs, and premiums for low sulphur diesel were rising despite the imminent arrival of several U.S. cargoes.
Fuel oil was steady, but many dealers remained bullish for the next few weeks.
